test_verification.note: 21 unit tests, all passing. Reference values independently derived by five agents, unanimous.

changes.summary: Fix silent 1000x locale parsing bug; add margin-percent mode, spread/commission and free-margin capping to risk sizing; add instrument table and validated rates layer

test_verification.note: 44 tests passing. parseFloat('1,085')===1 and comma-stripping both produce 1000x errors; ambiguous input is now refused.

rollback_steps: Revert parseDecimal in calc.js and restore the comma-strip in num()

protected_patterns.reason: Verified financial math. Reference values cross-checked five ways; the CFD-vs-FX margin branch, USD-anchored triangulation, closing-rate P/L conversion and round-down risk sizing are all load-bearing and must not be 'simplified'.

Untrusted third-party input boundary. Validation is fail-closed and the fetch must stay header-free: open.er-api.com answers OPTIONS with 405, so any custom header triggers a preflight that kills the request in-browser while still working in curl.

security_audit_log.finding: parseFloat/comma-strip locale bug caused a silent 1000x notional error on EU-locale price entry
security_audit_log.resolution: parseDecimal refuses ambiguous input rather than guessing
